text:
ajay: Heads-up — we saw a big wave of preemptible evictions last night. Thinking about adding a proactive migration path: when eviction risk is high, migrate long-running in-flight requests to reserved/dedicated capacity instead of waiting for eviction. Thoughts?
sophia: Do we have a per-instance eviction signal we trust? cloud provides spot-impending-notice + we have a heuristic evict_prob from telemetry.
lucas: We do. evict_prob is noisy but usable. Main concern is cost: migration doubles spot+reserved usage short-term. Need a cost model.
kate: Agreed on cost model. Simple rule: migrate if eviction_prob * redo_cost > migration_cost. redo_cost = expected wasted compute + latency penalty.
ajay: Sketch: if evict_prob > 0.6 AND remaining_eta > 120s AND tenant_reserved_quota_available then trigger migrate. Otherwise let preemptible finish.
sophia: Edge cases: migrating many tasks at once could overflow reserved pools -> admission must check burst headroom. Also avoid oscillation (migrate back/forth).
lucas: Add a per-task cooldown (e.g., 5m) and per-tenant burst-credit check. Prefer migrating to a warm slice (hot-slice) instead of full new allocation when possible.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: flagged for canary rollout -> feature_flag=preemptive_migrate_v1, target=staging 33%
kate: Ownership question: who decides? My take: control-plane evaluates policy, operator executes migration. Keep operator stateless for simpler rollback.
ajay: That matches my preference. Control-plane returns Recommendation {score, ttl, reason}, operator rechecks admission and executes. Example proto (pseudocode):
```
{ "request_id": "r123", "recommendation": "migrate", "score": 0.74, "ttl_s": 60 }
```
sophia: Observability: add metrics migrations_per_hour, migration_success_ratio, avg_latency_post_migration, cost_delta_by_tenant. Need traces linking original request -> migrated request.
lucas: Rollout plan: 1) canary low-spend tenants 2) monitor metrics for 48h 3) broaden to burst-eligible tenants. Circuit-breaker: auto-disable if weekly cost delta > 5% or migration_success_ratio < 90%.
kate: Also update billing/reporting: tag tokens/compute for migrated work so cost attribution stays correct. And add a reconciliation job to catch failed double-charges.
ajay: I'll open an RFC PR with heuristics, sample decision function, tests, and rollout steps. Will include a small sim harness to tune thresholds.
sophia: For sim: model eviction as Bernoulli with p=evict_prob over remaining_eta, include cost params (spot_rate, reserved_rate, warmup_time). Good call.
lucas: One more: prefer prewarm-only migration for short ETA tasks to avoid provisioning full-slot. Means we transfer KV-cache/context and route to warm prewarmed worker. Lower cost.
kate: Nice. Add a migration cooldown per-tenant and a max-migrations-per-minute global cap to protect reserved pool.
ajay: OK — will draft and ping y'all. If no objections I'll enable feature_flag in staging tomorrow. :+1:
